description:
## [1.5.0](https://github.com/itsthejoker/itsthejoker-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0) (2026-07-28)

### ✨ New Features

* **roost:** add free nest egg patch ([5df866e](https://github.com/itsthejoker/itsthejoker-patches/commit/5df866e98cbdbec69c11632b1f170ee5a971642c))
* **roost:** force deploy ([a86dfae](https://github.com/itsthejoker/itsthejoker-patches/commit/a86dfae2e271cd47a39ef67c72d7d63cf8899a6a))

patches.name: 10x Bullet Damage
patches.description: Multiplies the player's bullet damage by 10 in the Bullet Hell minigame (damage 1 -> 10), applied to both enemies and bosses.

patches.name: Beam of Death (10x Fire Rate)
patches.description: Multiplies the player's firing speed by 10 in the Bullet Hell minigame (fire interval 0.15 -> 0.015) for a near-continuous beam.

patches.name: Bypass Play Store license check
patches.description: Disables the PairIP Play-license check so a non-Play (e.g. patched/sideloaded) install no longer redirects to the "get it on Google Play" wall on launch.

patches.name: Free Nest Egg (bypass claim cooldown)
patches.description: Removes the client-side cooldown timer check on the nest-egg free-bird claim button so the claim request is sent to the server on every tap. The server still controls eligibility; this only stops the client from blocking the request.

patches.name: Redirect Google login to microG
patches.description: Routes Roost's Google Play Services calls to microG RE so a patched install can sign in with Google. Requires microG RE (app.revanced.android.gms) installed.

patches.name: Skip Play Integrity (fix microG Firebase delay)
patches.description: Makes Play Integrity attestation fail fast instead of hanging ~60s under microG, removing the delay before Firebase logins, leaderboards, and other backend calls.

patches.name: Triple Bullet Size
patches.description: Triples the on-screen size of the player's bullets in the Bullet Hell minigame (sizePx 6.0 -> 18.0).
